fact_text: Analyst judged International Steels' results as good when measured against its sales, and the dividend as a positive surprise for shareholders.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: International Industries, the holding company of International Steels, also declared a dividend in the same period.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Mari Petroleum reported a half-year dividend that the analyst described as very strong, though its payout ratio is a little low.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Analyst expects Mari Petroleum's EPS and dividends to improve in future years as ongoing hydrocarbon discoveries add production.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Airlink assembles mobile phones in Pakistan from imported CKD kits, also runs distribution, and has received notices to assemble televisions.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Analyst said Airlink's dividend is very good and that investors should welcome it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Mobile phone assembly plants in Pakistan are facing problems with the supply of CKD kits imported for assembly.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: The Japanese side of Pak Suzuki Motor rejected the buyback offer price made to minority shareholders.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Analyst was surprised the buyback price was not higher, expecting electric vehicle demand in Pakistan to support the company's real value.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Analyst said cement companies trade at roughly USD 30 to 40 per ton, which he called cheap on a regional comparison.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Cement makers' margins look very good even though capacity utilisation and domestic consumption are low.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Analyst put Islamic banks' spreads at about 7 percent, with high yields on earning assets, mostly from sukuk investments.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Earning assets are a bank's advances and investments, and the return earned on them is the yield on earning assets, a key measure for comparing banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)

fact_text: Analyst sees Islamic banks and cement as relatively safe places for capital, even if politics or the economy weaken.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Update, Economy Insights, and Strategic Investing.' (YouTube, 2024-01-31)
